draft.emotion: checking the time quickly, practical and hurried
notes: Used directly after a number without a measure word (e.g., 五分钟 = five minutes).
分钟 expresses duration ('for five minutes'), whereas 分 (fēn) is used when telling the time on the clock (e.g., 三点五分 = 3:05).
